user.name: Utso
user.github_intent: single user, AI-optimized repo as memory/handover, not human portfolio

constraints: 8GB RAM tight for large models - use quantized qwen2.5:3b baseline ~2GB
No native build tools assumed - bat files must handle
Ollama already installed separately, qwen2.5:3b already pulled

current_runtime.vault_api: in-process in the desktop app (src/main/vault/) - there is NO port 8765 in this app and the extension cannot reach it yet
current_runtime.dev_server: npm run dev (Electron) | npm run preview:web (browser preview on 4174)
current_runtime.ollama_origins: not needed by the Electron app; Ollama is called from the main/app side, not a browser page

app_identity.name: OddBrain
app_identity.theme_default: dark, tokenised: accent #7c5cff by default, conversation width 760px, both changeable in Settings > Appearance
app_identity.window: fully on-screen, Windows title bar + close controls visible
app_identity.chat_target: the owner's own approved mockups (chat shell, appearance, the full-window settings rail) - not Claude pixel parity

capture_policy.default: check everything by default across all sites + all AIs after one-time permission
capture_policy.on_inaccessible: log "wasn't accessible - reason" in 09 Activity & Undo + 01 Inbox/Processing Errors, no popup/ask
capture_policy.explicit_collect: right-click 'Collect this page now' or paste URL to force

blacklist.type: never-check blacklist, default allow explicit deny
blacklist.storage: 00 System/Privacy & Access.md + 00 System/Connectors/Source Scope.md excluded_patterns + chrome.storage.sync

capsule_hub.reference: Capsule Hub by Tilantra - Mozilla addon
features: capture once as reusable Capsule with goals/constraints/background/decisions/attachments
drag-drop inject into any AI chat box

quillbot.reference: Quillbot AI Writing - Chrome Web Store
features: works in background ready when needed
works in any text field across web
highlight text or open toolbar for instant suggestions

qwen2.5:3b_limits: interprets Flappy Bird example in system prompt as must create game every reply -> Tic Tac Toe loop
model_constraints.fix_tictactoe: override systemPrompt for qwen2.5:3b to simple assistant, only create artifacts when explicitly asked, clear localStorage chat_history
model_constraints.ui_vs_intelligence: UI parity != intelligence, don't promise local model equals Claude
model_constraints.model_aware: expose every verified option for selected model, hide/disable unsupported, update controls when model changes
